x-note-v130: Updated in v1.3.0 (historical): version set to 'v1.3.0'; versionCode set to 1030000; versionName set to 'v1.3.0 (Global Edition)'; releaseDate set to '2026-10-02'. The release was originally documented as client-side only (PWA install button + live status LED + DNS auto-start fix). That description was incomplete: v1.3.0 ALSO shipped server-side refinements that were not documented in this file — (a) main.go:buildBackupInfo() now detects snapshots by the presence of a `.manifest.json` file (SNAP-MANIFEST) instead of by name pattern, and sorts them by mtime for `last_backup_name` (SNAP-MTIME); (b) functions.sh:rotate_backups() was rewritten with the same manifest-based detection (ROT-MANIFEST), the same mtime sort (ROT-MTIME), and two additional protected targets on top of the 21-newest window — the `.last_stable` recovery pointer and the newest install snapshot (ROT-PROTECT); (c) service.sh gained a boot-path DNS auto-start (bounded wait for the WebUI to become ready, then a direct POST /api/ensure_running_service with the X-Watchdog-Token header). The same refinements were applied in parallel to watchdog.sh (§[5b] snapshot counter), status.sh (_list_snapshots), customize.sh (rotate_backups), action.sh (_inline_rotate_backups + _inline_backup_summary), and uninstall.sh (§[5b] BACKUP_COUNT / BACKUP_LAST_NAME). See CHANGELOG.md [v1.3.0] and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.13.

See CHANGELOG.md [v1.4.0].

x-note-changelog-alias: The fields 'changelog' and 'changelogUrl' both point to the same CHANGELOG.md raw URL. This is intentional: some root managers (Magisk, KernelSU) read 'changelog', while others read 'changelogUrl'. Providing both maximises compatibility without duplicating content.
x-note-zip-url-template: zipUrl is generated by scripts/release.sh using the template: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/dnscrypt-webui-<version-without-v>-module.zip — where <tag> is the annotated tag created by release.sh (e.g. 'v1.4.0') and <version-without-v> is the same tag stripped of its leading 'v' (e.g. '1.4.0'). The tag and the URL are written in the same commit, so they are always consistent. For v1.4.0: tag = 'v1.4.0', version-without-v = '1.4.0', final URL = '.../releases/download/v1.4.0/dnscrypt-webui-1.4.0-module.zip'.
